tooltip.exaltedDefinition: A planet placed in the one sign where it works at its strongest and best.
tooltip.debilitatedDefinition: A planet placed in the one sign where it struggles the most.
tooltip.ownSignDefinition: A planet placed in a sign it naturally rules — comfortable and confident.
tooltip.neutralDefinition: A planet placed in an ordinary sign — neither its best nor its most strained.
tooltip.retrogradeDefinition: A planet that appears to move backward from Earth's view — its themes turn inward and get revisited.
tooltip.combustDefinition: A planet sitting too close to the Sun — its own effects get overpowered and harder to see clearly.
tooltip.nakshatraDefinition: One of 27 lunar mansions the Moon passes through — a finer layer of meaning than the zodiac sign alone.
tooltip.padaDefinition: A quarter-division of a nakshatra (1 to 4) that further refines its meaning.

periodType.grind: This is a genuinely hard stretch — progress will be slower than you'd like, but what you build carefully now tends to last.
periodType.instability: This period brings real unpredictability — old patterns may not hold, so stay flexible rather than forcing a fixed plan.
